headline: Clean 2.5ft SE with offshore dawn — the other strong pick today.
today: Right there with Ditch for best of the day. Good SE angle to 2.5ft, offshore NNE-to-N through the morning, then it goes light in the afternoon — clean all day, essentially. Fish or shortboard if the bigger sets connect, log if it backs off. If you're up for the RI drive, today delivers.

daysToWatch.note: Big at 2.2-3.2ft but SSW onshore all day on a fair angle — plenty of size, expect it bumpy.
Solid 2-2.8ft on a good SSE angle with a manageable ESE cross morning — the best-sized clean-ish window later in the week.
